_comment: ADOPT: one file per service at docs/governance/services/<service-id>.json (Loom 2.0 §7.4, R1–R6). A drill is a SIGNED OBSERVATION (rc.36, flow-plan Phase 2.4): observed_at + what the drill showed + a negative_test the mechanism REFUSED (result must be "rejected") + an observer_identity OUTSIDE the builders group + an ed25519 attestation by a registered issuer over the record's canonical hash minus the attestation (scripts/operational-readiness-check.mjs exports drillHash). The placeholders below are deliberately unadoptable — this template FAILS the gate until you have actually run each drill and recorded it. A bare ISO-date string is still accepted for THIS release with a printed deprecation NOTICE; it disappears next release. Freshness windows: BCP/DR 365d, rollback 180d, kill-switch 90d, capacity 365d.

last_exercised.observed_at: ADOPT: ISO date of your last DR exercise

observation.note: ADOPT: what the exercise demonstrated (e.g. failover to the secondary region in 47m; RPO held at 11m)

negative_test.attempted: ADOPT: the probe the mechanism must refuse (e.g. promotion of a stale replica)

last_exercised.observer_identity: ADOPT: a registry identity OUTSIDE the builders group

last_drilled.observed_at: ADOPT: ISO date of your last rollback drill

observation.note: ADOPT: what the drill demonstrated (e.g. rolled back to vN-1 in 6m; limits reconciled)

negative_test.attempted: ADOPT: the probe the mechanism must refuse (e.g. writes against the rolled-back schema)

last_drilled.observer_identity: ADOPT: a registry identity OUTSIDE the builders group

kill_switch.mechanism: feature flag credit.decisioning.enabled → manual underwriting queue

last_tested.observed_at: ADOPT: ISO date of your last kill-switch test

observation.note: ADOPT: what flipping it showed (e.g. decisioning drained to the manual queue in 90s)

negative_test.attempted: ADOPT: the probe the mechanism must refuse (e.g. traffic routed through the killed path)

last_tested.observer_identity: ADOPT: a registry identity OUTSIDE the builders group

_progressive_delivery_comment: ADOPT (rc.39 · flow-plan Phase 5.3) — R3b: HOW this service reaches customers. Optional for a service that is not doing staged exposure; MANDATORY the moment a compiled plan requires the exposure_control capability (regulated-bank declares it at high tier). strategy: canary | blue-green | ring. stages: strictly increasing traffic_pct ending at 100, each with a bake_minutes and the slo_refs it watches while baking. automated_rollback.trigger_slo must be one of those SLOs — a trigger on a signal the rollout does not observe never fires — and last_tested is a SIGNED OBSERVATION in the same shape as the drills above, on a 90-day window: an automated rollback nobody has fired is a configuration, not a control. feature_flag_ref must name the same key as the entry in docs/governance/feature-flags.json, so 'we can turn it off' is ONE claim rather than two about two switches.

last_tested.observed_at: ADOPT: ISO date you last FIRED the automated rollback trigger (90-day window)

observation.note: ADOPT: what firing it showed (e.g. error-rate breach at 12% traffic auto-reverted to vN-1 in 90s; no manual step)

negative_test.attempted: ADOPT: the probe the mechanism must refuse (e.g. ramp advanced past the next stage while the trigger SLO was breaching)

last_tested.observer_identity: ADOPT: a registry identity OUTSIDE the builders group

last_run.observed_at: ADOPT: ISO date of your last stress test

observation.note: ADOPT: what the run showed (e.g. 2.4x peak sustained for 1h; p99 within SLO)

negative_test.attempted: ADOPT: the probe the mechanism must refuse (e.g. load beyond the declared ceiling)
negative_test.result: ADOPT: must be "rejected" (e.g. shed, not served degraded-silently)

last_run.observer_identity: ADOPT: a registry identity OUTSIDE the builders group

reconciliation: daily limits-vs-ledger reconciliation; breaks page operations
failed_transaction_recovery: idempotent limit commands; replay from audit trail after recovery
complaints_readiness: care scripts + remediation matrix published; complaints tagged to product PRD-017
regulatory_notification_triggers: customer-impacting outage > 2h, or any data incident, per incident runbook
